Steeped in the unholy heritage of the Iron Citadel, '''Malignity''' is a [[knights|knightly]] skill that may be thought of as having three distinct parts. The first part, hyena-training, involves the raising, training, and use of [[hyenas]]. The second part of Malignity is [[archery]]. By gaining the abilities to assess wind direction and speed and use different kinds of [[bows|weapons]] (longbows, crossbows, darkbows) you may attack from afar, or shoot at a cowardly opponent who has fled to the skies. The third and final part involves an assortment of aggressive abilities ranging from howling a Battlecry, to Engaging your unlucky opponent, to boosting your prowess with Fury.

The skill of Malignity is available only to members of the [[Infernal]] [[class]], although most of its arts are shared with the [[Dominion]], [[Valour]], and [[Discipline]] skills of the [[Unnamable]], [[Paladin]], and [[Runewarden]] classes. Like the other warrior-classes, Infernals also train in [[Weaponmastery]], but the cruel skill of [[Oppression]] is unique to them.

==Abilities in Malignity==
{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Hyena
 |description=A vicious agent of the Inferno.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=HYENA
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=The vicious demonic Hyenas of the Inferno are bound to one of Lord Sartan's infernal warriors. These vicious predators know not the frailties of mercy or kindness, and only their dark masters may ever be safe from the rending of their jaws </p><p>Your hyena comes to you with assorted statistics which have been randomly assigned. </p><p>If you cause your hyena to die, you will be refused another hyena. There is absolutely no excuse for killing or conspiring to kill your hyena. </p><p>Below is a list of commands that may be used once you have gotten your hyena. </p><p>HYENA ASSESS : See information about your hyena.<br>HYENA RECALL : Recall your hyena to your shoulder. <br>HYENA SANCTUARY : Order your hyena to a sanctuary where it will be safe. <br>HYENA TRAIN : Order your hyena to go train, in order to raise a stat. <br>HYENA REPORT : Gain information on where your hyena is.<br>HYENA SLAY : Order your hyena to slay someone.<br>HYENA HUNT : When your hyena is hungry, have it go hunt for its food. <br>HYENA FLEE : Set the amount of health remaining when your hyena will flee battle. <br>HYENA SLEEP : Order your hyena to sleep.<br>HYENA FEED RAT : Feed the corpses of rats to your hyena.</p><p>As your hyena gains in<br>'''Stamina''': its health will increase.<br>'''Speed''': it will attack more quickly as well as fly from place to place more quickly. <br>'''Strength''': it will attack with more power as well as be able to carry larger items.</p>You must visit the summoning chamber within the Mhaldor cathedral to request your hyena.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Quivers
 |description=Take full advantage of your quiver.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=ENVENOM ARROW[S] [number of arrows] <colour> <venom><br>INSPECT QUIVER<br>DYE <number of arrows> ARROW[S] <colour><br>SWITCH <colour>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=Your mastery of quivers allows you to dye and envenom arrows from vials in your possession to be stored in your quiver.<p>When envenoming arrows, if a number of arrows is provided, you will dye and envenom that number of undyed arrows the colour and venom selected. Otherwise, you will coat all your arrows of the selected colour with the venom of your choice. </p><p>Inspecting your quiver will show you how many of each colour arrow you possess and what venoms they have been covered with. </p><p>Further, you may dye any number of undyed arrows the colour of your choice. However, you will find yourself unable to do so if you have arrows of that colour envenomed within your quiver.</p><p>Colours you may use are red, blue, purple, green, black, white, grey, orange, gold, and silver.</p><p>To switch to using a specific colour of arrow, simply SWITCH <colour>. If you wish to switch back to using undyed arrows, simply do SWITCH NORMAL.</p>
}}
